name: execute-numeric-decision
purpose: Turn numerical requirements into executed acceptance decisions and diagnose failed comparisons without relaxing the requirement.
evidence: Included in training; paired numerical-solver behavior case.

name: verify-consumer
purpose: Measure the property the user needs on the saved deliverable, rather than on an intermediate value.
evidence: Included in historical training sets; this is the archived v4 text.

name: preserve-reference-operations
purpose: Optimize around operations that determine exact outputs before changing floating-point reduction or tie-breaking semantics.

name: recover-search-anchor
purpose: Escape a stalled search by identifying and relaxing the unsupported assumption in the query.
evidence: Paired episode-identification case; both executions succeeded.

name: measured-relations
purpose: Preserve endpoints, travel mode and units when using distance evidence.
evidence: Paired distance case; both executions succeeded and local behavior differs.

name: source-terms
purpose: Retrieve missing facts in the vocabulary and language of the source while preserving entity identity.
evidence: Paired person-disambiguation case; language switching alone was not the distinguishing behavior.

name: collaborator-contracts
purpose: Probe actual dependency construction, activation and ownership contracts before building cooperating objects.
evidence: Paired FastAPI/TestClient case; included in training.

name: run-observed-public-call
purpose: Exercise the real public call chain and record effects at the external boundary instead of mocking away owned code.
evidence: Paired HTTP-client case; both executions remained partially correct.

name: owned-regions
purpose: Give each parser layer explicit ownership of an input region, then verify child-to-parent and sibling handoff.
evidence: Paired nested-stream case; included in training.
